per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code (e.g., 1026)
Account_No values must be unique
Name must be in Title Case format (e.g., 'Wang Shi Jie'), not all-caps or all-lowercase
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC format: one prefix letter (S/T/F/G), followed by exactly 7 digits, ending with one checksum letter (e.g., S1234567D)
ID_No values must be unique
ID_No must not contain obvious test or placeholder values
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must be either Male or Female
Age must be numeric and parseable as a number
Age must be between 0 and 120 (inclusive)
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9; or with 65 country code prefix)
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace (e.g., user@example.com)
Email values must be unique
Country must be 'Singapore' (standardized from variants like 'SG', 'S'pore', 'Singapura', '新加坡', 'Republic of Singapore')
Street_Name must not be in all uppercase (e.g., 'Holland Road' not 'HOLLAND ROAD')
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must contain 4 to 6 digits when represented as string (e.g., 6907, 99999, 410633)
Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column: Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female
Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
ID_No must match the corresponding ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Name should match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for formatting differences)
S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key)
